rules.text: Website chat and website voice offer eligible custom functions only. Built-in calendar booking and availability are excluded. Phone and eligible SMS can use a configured calendar.
rules.why: Website tools are selected separately for that number.

rules.text: The public API does not return ready-to-paste install HTML.
rules.instead: Use the dashboard Install action for each customer’s number. The settings read includes install_id. An install receipt only reports that a widget was seen.

rules.text: Configure each number’s sms_prompt for SMS and web_prompt for website chat and voice. Neither channel inherits its phone custom_prompt. Both still use the agent knowledge enabled for that channel and follow their own channel rules.
Enable website custom functions only when every enabled function on that number is safe for public visitors. To offer booking, share the business’s booking link or hand off to phone or SMS.
The website prompt has its own character limit, [[num-prompt.web_prompt]]. The phone and SMS prompt limits are separate.
Read the number’s widget settings and install ID.
On widget_settings_changed reload the saved settings before applying your edit.
